notices.title: Snishaper-Droid 1.30.3.2 发布
notices.body:
本次更新内容：
- chore(release): v1.30.3.2 (release) by @github-actions[bot] in `76b66b35ae4abf8fdb32932187961cb1d6c8f677`
- ci(release): accept 4-part hotfix versions (e.g. 1.30.3.2) by @dongle in `2c5210459941a897453048282a6ee4d4209a19ec`
- ci(android): skip syntax-bot jobs on fork PRs by @dongle in `e2a383b1944b1488e35650938cc6ada534dd2538`
- ci: remove the one-shot v1.0.0 announcement workflow by @dongle in `69e1b2983687073a4f9bc086a1af3d23935312ae`
- ci: one-shot workflow to publish the v1.0.0 announcement the release run could not deliver by @dongle in `feb2d3b7387f235a41c1aeee9b262bb91e5a9a2a`
- fix(ci): send a browser-compatible User-Agent on the announcement requests to pass Cloudflare's bot check by @dongle in `2caf668645d430e1252217916987864288c77416`
- fix(gomobile): unexport the notices payload types so gomobile keeps the App-only Java surface by @dongle in `edf277a6df4916bb70766e29c8c5a108ddadf713`
- chore(release): v1.0.0 (release) by @github-actions[bot] in `abfb066fab46f71a5c20ef0d6097fdab36c956d0`
- docs(spec): mark verification tasks complete and fix the gen-defaults assets path by @dongle in `f3b5650dfb9252c380cda87739a4eb1351b68e1b`
- fix(build): regenerate the 226-group default rules and align the test assertions by @dongle in `36905131baa5d53d12702839d3bbe7fe5be265d9`
- docs(spec): mark T022 complete by @dongle in `c0d5c4c9d59fa5a81b722b9ceab39d9d598addf8`
- docs(spec): add the droid-notices-migration spec by @dongle in `2cb44e147b1632b3e310e156ff5796c2e117dbcd`
- feat(android): port the desktop notices feature and add the SnishaperDroid announcement channel by @don...

完整更新日志与下载资产见本次发版页面：https://github.com/SnishaperTeam/Snishaper-Droid/releases/tag/v1.30.3.2
